Arra Veterinary Clinic is a small animal practice, located within Tipperary town. We are committed to providing the highest level of care to our patients and also to their owners. Arra Vets opened in 2007 and since then we have expanded our services and facilities to meet the ever changing demands of veterinary pet care. You and your pets will be treated like family, while receiving the best and most compassionate care that we can provide.

I love to talk all things animal and enjoy giving advice and pet tips and hints.
